title: Evening Dispatch Sol 10
headline: Evening Dispatch
anchor_intro: Good evening, Enclave. From our perch in the interior communications array, the ferrofluid sea outside thrashes violently, with peaks of magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear crashing against the glass. The sharp scent of ionized air filters through the vents, and a low hum vibrates beneath our boots, while the metallic tang of ozone rests on the tongue. We must DEFEND the lower bulkheads against the corrosive spray, CONCEAL our sensitive arrays from the magnetic interference, and ATTRACT the rogue lightning strikes into our grounding pylons.
broadcast_script: Ryn taps the microphone, brushing a smudge of grease from the console. 'The shear waves are peaking. If we miscalculate the magnetic dampeners, we risk blowing the primary relays, leaving us blind. We have to fail forward—if the primary relays fry, we channel the surge into the secondary thermal cores to keep the habitat warm.' She then physically hands the heavy, brass-rimmed microphone to Silas, their fingers brushing against the cold metal. 'Your turn, Silas. Do not let the static bite.'

# Evening Dispatch

Ryn hands the mic to Silas.
